newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM INT TO LIST IN AMSTERDAM FROM DEC 12.
newsitem.headline: ASM INT TO LIST IN AMSTERDAM FROM DEC 12.

text.p: ASM International NV said on Monday it planned an offering of 4.1 million ordinary shares outside the United States and that its shares would be listed on the Amsterdam stock exchange from December 12.
ASM International, which makes equipment used to produce semiconductor devices, is already listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange in the United States.
The company announced provisional plans for an offering of some four million shares and an Amsterdam bourse listing earlier this month.
At present ASM International has 31.5 million ordinary shares outstanding.
The current offering comprises 1.5 million new shares to be issued by the company and 2.6 million shares to be sold by existing shareholders.
Merrill Lynch International is lead manager of the underwriting syndicate with ABN AMRO Rothschild and ING Barings acting as co-lead manager and co-manager respectively.
The price of the offering is expected to be set on December 12 by a book-building process under which investors indicate how many shares they want and the price they are willing to pay.
An additional 615,000 shares may be offered to cover any overallotments.
ASM International said the offering was intended to create additional liquidity in its shares for European investors.

Based on Nasdaq prices of November 27, the offering of 1.5 million new shares will raise some 26 million guilders for the company. ASM International said it would use the proceeds to reduce its debts and for "general corporate purposes".
